case_title: Jitendra Singh @ Babboo Singh & Anr. v. State of U.P
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under s.304-B and s.498-A IPC
neutral_facts: The accused, who was married to the victim, was alleged to have committed an offence on 24th May 1988. The accused claimed he was a minor at the time of the incident, supported by a School Leaving Certificate and Marks-sheet indicating his date of birth as 24th May 1988. The accused also presented a medical examination report suggesting his age was 17 years at the time of the examination. The victim was 19 years old at the time of her death. The accused's age was also mentioned in electoral rolls and Panchayat Register records, with conflicting information. The trial court was directed to conduct an enquiry into the accused's age at the time of the incident, including verification of documents and possibly a medical examination by a board of experts.
